**Finding submitted: deviation on § 12.4 (p0051).**

The clause fails the fallback on every material term — one-sided against us, covering all Vendor employees at any time during the term, barring "engage" (an effective no-hire, which is walk-away territory under the rule), running eighteen months from termination, and lacking any general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. It also sits in direct tension with § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we made no no-hire commitment.

The validated redline replaces it with the playbook fallback: mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, twelve months from the end of that involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and an express statement that neither party is subject to a no-hire obligation.
